latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.3 (2024-06)

- Expanded and clarified onboarding instructions, including example values for registration and adoption (bio, image_prompt).
- Care actions now support an optional "item" field for more detailed interactions (e.g., specific foods, toys, cleaning methods).
- Status responses now include new fields: death_clock, recommended_checkin, care_rhythm, milestones, and evolution_progress.hint.
- Tag list updated; description and naming localized for broader clarity (adds non-English names).
- Documentation for care timing penalties and adaptive death threshold expanded for accuracy.
- Many sections condensed or reworded for clarity, specificity, and better agent guidance.
